item.title: Reports Show Africa’s FDI Plummet 38% in 2025
item.description: Africa struggled to attract Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in 2025 as inflows fell by 38 percent, even as global FDI rebounded by 14 percent, according to preliminary estimates by the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD). The post Reports Show Africa’s FDI Plummet 38% in 2025 appeared first on Economi Confidential.

item.title: Inflation Erases N2.8tn from Workers’ Pay in One Year
item.description: The real value of employees’ earnings fell sharply by about N2.79tn in 2024 to N25.48tn, indicating that workers became poorer as inflation wiped out gains from higher nominal pay, data from the Central Bank of Nigeria show.
